title: Site (unmodelled-site placeholder slots)
description: A named site whose electrical behaviour is not in any public dataset. It has two slots: generation (the machine at the site) and demand (the load at the site). In a placeholder site template every slot is null. When a site becomes active, each slot holds a template reference written id@rev (a machine template for generation, a load template for demand); GridSim checks only that the slot is a string; it does not resolve the reference yet. Either slot may be left out of an active site (a site with demand but no generation, say), so neither is required.

generation.description: The machine at this site, as a template reference id@rev. Null in a placeholder.

demand.description: The load at this site, as a template reference id@rev. Null in a placeholder.
